verdict.rationale: AvaTax exposes MCP-server tools (transaction creation, nexus retrieval, tax-code recommendations, rate lookups) that let an AI agent invoke tax operations programmatically, and Managed Returns API embeds filing into partner workflows — both are building blocks for agent-driven automation, but there is no documented feature for scheduling, triggering, or running these operations autonomously in the background without an external orchestrator. Missing for 10: evidence of built-in scheduling/triggers, webhook-driven autonomous jobs, or a first-party 'set it and forget it' automation/agent runtime rather than just callable API/MCP tools.
